notes.nkkuse: Ma a ndri ra: I am full.

guidebook.intro: Cooking. Recipes are a chain of commands: **Kakau ka tungulu** (first cut the onions).

tips.title: Kakau, vutia
body: **Kakau** first, **vutia** then. **Ji dele aci dria** (put the pot on the fire), **Ji mafuta kpe** (add oil).
**Nyaka de ra. Ama nya!** (the food is ready. Let’s eat!)

tips.title: Awa’difo nyaka ozo ni
body: Thank the cook with **Awa’difo nyaka ozo ni**. **Ma a ndri ra** (my belly is heavy) means I’m full.
**Nya dri ago si** (eat with the right hand).

culture.title: Kalo and sauce
body: A West Nile meal is often a firm millet or cassava bread with a sauce of beans, fish, meat or greens.
